extracted.intended_audience: journalists, members of the media, and CUNY staff/college contacts seeking communications, marketing, or media-relations support
extracted.subtask_description: Directory and resource landing page for the CUNY Office of Communications & Marketing: provides contact emails/phone numbers, lists internal divisions, and links to guidelines and service request processes for press and university stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: For press inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: For press inquiries, please email mediarelations@cuny.edu.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this email address for media/press questions and outreach; the page lists a dedicated Media Relations team (e.g., Press Secretary Noah Gardy) to handle such inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: For non-press inquiries
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this general office email for questions that are not press/media related (administrative, internal coordination, general communications requests).

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for Services
rubrics_metrics.description: Request for Services (link listed on the page).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Service requests should be submitted through the office's Request for Services process (page provides link/menu item). Specific submission details are available via that linked process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Branding Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Branding Guidelines (link listed on the page).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications and marketing materials should adhere to CUNY's Branding Guidelines linked from this page; follow the linked guidance for logos, identity, and brand usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Social Media Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Social Media Guidelines (link listed on the page).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All social-media content and conduct should conform to the CUNY Social Media Guidelines referenced on this page; consult the linked document for platform-specific rules and best practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Website Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Website Guidelines (link listed on the page).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Web content and site decisions should follow the CUNY Website Guidelines linked from this page; consult that guidance for standards on web publishing and style.

rubrics_metrics.name: Align communications with CUNY's mission
rubrics_metrics.description: The CUNY Office of Communications and Marketing works in partnership with the University’s academic and administrative offices and the 26 colleges to promote CUNY’s unique mission and transformative role as an engine of social mobility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications produced or approved by the office should promote CUNY's mission and emphasize its role in social mobility; messaging should reflect institutional priorities and partnership with colleges and units.

rubrics_metrics.name: Route requests to the appropriate division
rubrics_metrics.description: The office includes eight divisions: Communications, Creative, Marketing, Social Media, Multimedia, University Events, Citizenship Now!, and CUNY TV.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requests and work should be directed to the appropriate internal division (e.g., social platforms to Social Media team, video to Multimedia/CUNY TV, events to University Events); the page lists staff contacts for each team to facilitate routing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scheduling contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: For scheduling, contact Debra Zechowski and Monica Tavares (listed with roles and contact information).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the named scheduling contacts (emails/phone numbers provided) to arrange meetings, interviews, or other scheduled activities involving the Senior Vice Chancellor for Communications & Marketing or related staff.
